entries.en: He spread soft cheese on an oatcake.
entries.zh: 他在燕麦饼上抹了软奶酪。

entries.en: The suitcase contained nightwear and a change of clothes.
entries.zh: 行李箱里装着睡衣和一套换洗衣服。

entries.en: The kittenish puppy chased its tail across the rug.
entries.zh: 那只像小猫一样爱耍闹的小狗在地毯上追着自己的尾巴。

entries.en: A small confectionary opened beside the station.
entries.zh: 一家小糖果店在车站旁开业了。

entries.en: The location of the treasure remained unrevealed.
entries.zh: 宝藏的位置仍未揭露。

entries.en: The review was an excoriation of the committee's failures.
entries.zh: 这篇评论严厉责难了委员会的种种失败。

entries.en: The analogy made a difficult concept graspable.
entries.zh: 这个类比使一个困难的概念变得能理解。

entries.en: Pigweed grew thickly along the neglected fence.
entries.zh: 失于照管的篱笆边长满了藜。

entries.en: The anthologist selected poems from several generations of writers.
entries.zh: 选集编者从几代作家的作品中挑选了诗歌。

entries.en: The grappler pinned an opponent to the mat.
entries.zh: 格斗者把对手压在了垫子上。

entries.en: The shofar sounded during the solemn ceremony.
entries.zh: 羊角号在庄严的仪式中响起。

entries.en: The inspector checked whether the damaged building remained insurable.
entries.zh: 检查员核查了受损建筑是否仍可投保。

entries.en: The analysis tested the substitutability of the two materials.
entries.zh: 这项分析检验了两种材料的可代换性。

entries.en: The festival reflects a syncretistic blend of religious traditions.
entries.zh: 这个节日体现了宗教传统相融合的特点。

entries.en: We spent the forenoon sorting boxes in the attic.
entries.zh: 我们整个上午都在阁楼上整理箱子。

entries.en: The schedule remains alterable until all participants confirm.
entries.zh: 在所有参与者确认之前，日程仍然可以修改。

entries.en: His gruffness concealed a willingness to help.
entries.zh: 他的粗鲁掩盖了他愿意帮忙的一面。

entries.en: The ingenuousness of her question disarmed the suspicious interviewer.
entries.zh: 她提问的率直消除了那位多疑采访者的戒心。

entries.en: A steel clevis connected the trailer to the drawbar.
entries.zh: 一个钢制U形钩把拖车连接在牵引杆上。

entries.en: The convertor supplies the voltage required by the device.
entries.zh: 变流器提供该设备所需的电压。

entries.en: He contrariwise refused every suggestion, however sensible.
entries.zh: 不管建议多么合理，他都顽固地拒绝。

entries.en: The old drill uses a rechargeable nicad.
entries.zh: 这把旧电钻使用一块可充电的镍镉蓄电池。

entries.en: A lucky guesser might choose the right answer immediately.
entries.zh: 运气好的猜测者可能立即选中正确答案。
